Visitor skip action omits all headings from output

```elixir title="Elixir"
visitor = %{
      :handle_heading => fn(_args) ->
        :skip
      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>Body text remains.</p>", %{visitor: visitor})
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
